verdicts.reason: A and B are practically the same image; B is only shifted by a pixel or two. Both share the same flaws. The translucent band is narrow and sits left of centre, and it does nothing for contrast. 'Save your money, enjoy your weekend' and both chevron sets sit directly on the busy skyline, so they are hard to read. The text block is small and leaves the top-right and the whole lower half as unused photo, so the result looks like a crop rather than a reworked layout.
